tools.name: devices
tools.description: List every iOS simulator and Android emulator on this worktree's worker with its id, OS, model and whether it is on, and which one the Simulator tab has focused. Band creates no device on its own: pick one in the Simulator tab or pass its id as `device` to the other tools.

tools.name: status
tools.description: Show the device the tools act on: its id, platform, whether it is on and its screen size. Android sizes are pixels, iOS sizes are points. Acts on the device named by `device`, else on the device in the last focused pane of the Simulator tab; with neither, answers with the list of devices and how to pick one.

device.description: Device id or name from simulator_devices. Without it the tool acts on the device in the pane of the Simulator tab that was focused last.

tools.name: screenshot
tools.description: Take a screenshot of an iOS simulator or Android emulator, turning it on first when it is off. Answers with the image and a line with its pixel size and the scale. On iOS, coordinates for simulator_tap are in points: pixels divided by scale. On Android they are pixels. Acts on the device named by `device`, else on the device in the last focused pane of the Simulator tab; with neither, answers with the list of devices and how to pick one.

device.description: Device id or name from simulator_devices. Without it the tool acts on the device in the pane of the Simulator tab that was focused last.

tools.name: describe
tools.description: Read the screen as a list of elements: each one's type, label, value and id, its frame and the point to tap it at. iOS reads the accessibility tree (points), Android reads uiautomator (pixels). Cheaper and more exact than reading a screenshot. Acts on the device named by `device`, else on the device in the last focused pane of the Simulator tab; with neither, answers with the list of devices and how to pick one.

device.description: Device id or name from simulator_devices. Without it the tool acts on the device in the pane of the Simulator tab that was focused last.

tools.name: tap
tools.description: Tap the screen. iOS coordinates are points: divide screenshot pixels by the scale that simulator_screenshot reports (3 on current iPhones). Android coordinates are pixels. Acts on the device named by `device`, else on the device in the last focused pane of the Simulator tab; with neither, answers with the list of devices and how to pick one.

device.description: Device id or name from simulator_devices. Without it the tool acts on the device in the pane of the Simulator tab that was focused last.

tools.name: type
tools.description: Type text on the device. On Android only printable ASCII can be typed. Acts on the device named by `device`, else on the device in the last focused pane of the Simulator tab; with neither, answers with the list of devices and how to pick one.

device.description: Device id or name from simulator_devices. Without it the tool acts on the device in the pane of the Simulator tab that was focused last.

tools.name: button
tools.description: Press a hardware button. HOME, LOCK, SIDE_BUTTON and SIRI work on iOS. HOME, BACK, APP_SWITCH, LOCK and SIDE_BUTTON work on Android. Acts on the device named by `device`, else on the device in the last focused pane of the Simulator tab; with neither, answers with the list of devices and how to pick one.

device.description: Device id or name from simulator_devices. Without it the tool acts on the device in the pane of the Simulator tab that was focused last.

tools.name: open_url
tools.description: Open a URL on the device. A web URL opens the browser, a custom scheme opens the app that registered it. Acts on the device named by `device`, else on the device in the last focused pane of the Simulator tab; with neither, answers with the list of devices and how to pick one.

device.description: Device id or name from simulator_devices. Without it the tool acts on the device in the pane of the Simulator tab that was focused last.

tools.name: install
tools.description: Install a build from this worktree: an .app folder on an iOS simulator or an .apk file on an Android emulator. Acts on the device named by `device`, else on the device in the last focused pane of the Simulator tab; with neither, answers with the list of devices and how to pick one.

path.description: Absolute path of the .app (iOS) or .apk (Android) inside this worktree

device.description: Device id or name from simulator_devices. Without it the tool acts on the device in the pane of the Simulator tab that was focused last.

tools.name: launch
tools.description: Launch an installed app: an iOS bundle id, or an Android package name (or package/activity). Acts on the device named by `device`, else on the device in the last focused pane of the Simulator tab; with neither, answers with the list of devices and how to pick one.

device.description: Device id or name from simulator_devices. Without it the tool acts on the device in the pane of the Simulator tab that was focused last.
